profile.headline: Software Engineer at AerSale, Inc.
profile.summary:
Experience in development of Desktop and Web applications with C# and the .NET
Framework. Strong Object Oriented Programming concepts and Modeling Techniques with strong
Mathematical and Algorithmic background. Deep understanding of relational concepts and strong
analytical skills. Familiar with the phases of the development lifecycle and with front and back-end
development. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Supporting ARI Application. This Application is the core application of the Amadeus Revenue Integrity office. It is use by millions of users. I am working on making changes required by users to fix bugs or to add new functionalities to an specific Airline or Carrier on the backend.

positions.title: Application Developer Analyst
positions.description: Develop Reports and Packages for insurance claims with SSRS, SSIS, C# and SQL Server 2014. Develop Tools to works with claims in C#, Windows Form, SQL Server 2014. Also maintaining a Web application to search for clinics and doctors based on given location and patient needs using HTML5, Bootstrap and PHP.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Working on the Digital FlowChart Application, making updates and changes required by the users. This App is web base, for internal use of the company and some Clients. The main purpose of this App is handle all the data about the clients, the media campaigns and ratings. Using Asp.NET MVC, C# and SQL Server 2010 and VS 2012, and Bootstrap on the Front-End.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed and Developed a Web Application for the admissions process online in Dade Medical College, using ASP.NET Web Forms, SQL Server and C# in Visual Studio 2010 and Bootstrap. The App stores and handles all the required data the applicants must bring to apply for a career in DMC and show the data entered for the applicant to Admission Team to process it. I participated in the design and development of the database using SQL Server 2008 and also in the construction of the business logic using C#.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: Designed and developed a software to check and evaluate the quality of water in Cuba. The software purpose was to keep track of different variables and statistics related to different measures of water quality made by INRH. Using SQL Server, C#, Windows Form and Visual Studio 2008. I worked in the design and development of the database using SQL Server 2008 and also in the construction of the business logic using C#.
